title: Nexstar Media Group to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: IRVING, TX — Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NXST) today announced that executive management will participate in four upcoming institutional investor
body_markdown:
**IRVING, TX —** Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NXST) today announced that executive management will participate in four upcoming institutional investor conferences in September:


- **Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference** Location: Hilton New York Hotel – New York, NY
Date: Tuesday, September 8, 2026
Fireside Chat Presentation: 9:30 a.m. ET
Participants: Perry A. Sook, Chairman and CEO and Lee Ann Gliha, EVP and CFO
- **BofA 2026 Media, Communications and Entertainment Conference** Location: Bank of America Pavilion – New York, NY
Date: Wednesday, September 9, 2026
Fireside Chat Presentation: 11:20 a.m. ET
Participants: Perry A. Sook, Chairman and CEO and Lee Ann Gliha, EVP and CFO
- **Goldman Sachs Communacopia and Technology Conference** Location: The Palace – San Francisco, CA
Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026
Fireside Chat Presentation: 1:45 p.m. PT
Participants: Perry A. Sook, Chairman and CEO and Lee Ann Gliha, EVP and CFO
- **Deutsche Bank’s 34th Annual Leveraged Finance Conference** Location: Fairmont Scottsdale – Scottsdale, AZ
Date: Tuesday, September 29, 2026
Participant: Lee Ann Gliha, EVP and CFO


A live webcast and replay of the Citi, BofA and Goldman Sachs fireside chats will be available through the “Events and Presentations” section under “Investor Relations” on Nexstar’s website at[www.nexstar.tv](https://www.nexstar.tv/events-and-presentations/) .


Please contact your Citi, BofA, Goldman Sachs or Deutsche Bank sales representative to register for the conferences and to request meetings with Nexstar management.


**###**


**About Nexstar Media Group, Inc.** Nexstar Media Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: NXST) is a leading diversified media company that produces and distributes engaging local and national news, sports and entertainment content across its television and digital platforms. For more information, please visit nexstar.tv.
